resources.string: Lets you know when last night has synced and is ready to check.
A nudge to get daylight soon after you wake up.
Last calls for caffeine, big meals, alcohol and hard workouts.
When to dim the lights and start your evening routine.
When your best window to fall asleep opens.
When your afternoon nap window opens.
Progress while sleep data is being imported.
A few minutes of outdoor light now sets your body clock for the day ahead.
Make this your last coffee or tea so it has worn off by bedtime.
Have your last large meal now so digestion has settled before bed.
Switch to something alcohol-free; a drink this late breaks up the second half of the night.
Finish intense exercise now so your body has time to cool down before bed.
Switch to low, warm light. It tells your body the evening has started.
Time to start easing toward bed.
This is your best stretch to fall asleep tonight. Head to bed when you can.
A short nap now can lift the rest of your day. Aim for 10–20 minutes; 30 can leave you groggy at first.
Take a few seconds to check it and see how your sleep debt moved.
Confirm or fix last night so your sleep debt stays accurate.
